en: A black-and-white aerial photograph showing a small village or rural settlement. The image features a number of detached houses surrounded by trees, with fields in the background. In the foreground, there is a prominent rectangular building, which may be a school or community center, with a courtyard or open area in front of it. Roads and minor lanes divide the settlement, and there is little to no modern infrastructure visible.
